name: Artist talk & screening: Elina Oikari (FI)
description:
On June 26th, artist in residence Elina Oikari will give a talk about her artistic process and show excerpts from her works.

The practice of Finnish artist and filmmaker Elina Oikari finds itself in the realm between art house cinema, media art and documentary film methodology centered around cinéma vérité and essay film.
Her work often deals with current social themes, timeless places, and absurd encounters. Oikari aims to challenge the conventional underlying narrative framework and sound design in video and filmmaking. Using a sharp palette of poetic narration and reflective visual language, she aims to push the boundaries of video and cinematic practices. Oikari is currently working on her debut docufiction.

It is free to participate in the artist talk and screening.

Elina Oikari holds a Master of Arts from the ELO Film School Finland in Aalto University (2014) and is currently a resident for three months at FABRIKKEN for Kunst og Design, as part of the FABRIKKEN Air programme kindly supported by The Finnish Cultural Foundation and The Danish Arts Foundation.

With solo exhibitions at Forum Box, Gallery Huuto and at Fotocenter Raseborg, Elina Oikari’s work has been widely shown, internationally as well with videos and film at festivals as New Horizons IFF, Wrocław 2022, Encounters FF, Bristol 2022, Go Short - ISFF Nijmegen 2022, Black Canvas CFF, México City 2022, FIFEQ Festival International du Film Ethnographique du Quebec 2021, Nordische Filmtage Lübeck 2021 & 2019, Tampere FF 2021 & 2019, Gijón IFF 2019 and Festival Curta Cinema - Rio de Janeiro 2018.

Learn more about Elina Olikari on her website: https://www.elinaoikari.com/

name: SUMMER PARTY: 🥘 Olla Común - South American Community Kitchen
description:
## Español ##

Hola a todes, esperamos que estén bien y estén disfrutando su verano 🌞

Les invitamos a la Olla Común del mes, el viernes 28 de Junio a las 18.30. Esta vez tendremos DJs desde las 19.00 🎵🪩🕺🏾💃🏽

El programa será así:

18.00 - Se ponen los parlantes y empezamos a preparar todo si pueden nos ayudan ;)
18.30 - Se sirve la comida
19.00 - Musica: Kip Analog
21.00 - Musica: Iki dalga (Garlic Sound Collective)\

Esta vez serviremos Frijoles Colombianos:
- Frijoles pinto
- Arrozito
- Bananos/platano *not guaranteed*
- Salsa de aji colombiana, hecha con wai ya
- Unas sangrías 👀

Les contaremos un poco de como funciona la Olla y también recaudaremos fondos, ya sea para mandarlos a personas o organizaciones que luchan en el Abya Yala por la soberanía y liberación de los pueblos indigenas o tal vez para comprar una olla a presión grande para que podamos hacer que los porotos salgan mas ricos ;)))

Nos vemos!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

## English ##

Hi everyone, we hope you are doing well and enjoying the summer 🌞

We invite you to the monthly Olla Comun, this friday the 28th of June at 18.30. This time with live DJs! 😎

The program will go like this:

18.00 - Set up of music and serving
18.30 - Food is served
19.00 - Music: Kip Analog
21.00 - Music: Iki dalga (Garlic Sound Collective)

As for food, we know you love them beans so we got some Frijoles Colombianos:
- Pinto beans
- Rice
- Fried plantain **no guarantee!**
- Spicy colombian sauce made with wai ya
- Sangria 🍷

We will also tell you how the Olla works and all your donations will either go to support groups and people that fight for the sovereignty and liberation of indigenous peoples in the Abya Yala, or to upgrade our kitchen equipment and get a big pressure cooker so we can make even better beans ;))

See you!
